profile:
### Dr. Steth — Ponyville hospital doctor

**Who is he?** A pale mint-green unicorn stallion with a spiky purple mane and tail, vivid green eyes, a teal-collared white medical coat, and a stethoscope cutie mark. Recognize him examining elderly Mr. Waddle with a magically held stethoscope in *On Your Marks*. He is a separate character from Dr. Horse and Doctor Horse.

**Appearances:** *Friendship is Magic* — “On Your Marks” (S6E4, with Mr. Waddle), “Where the Apple Lies” (S6E23, Ponyville hospital), and “A Flurry of Emotions” (S7E3, hospital). He appears as a background doctor; no identifiable spoken line or voice actor was verified. [Episode/character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).

**Name and continuity:** “Dr Steth” was used as an unofficial background-pony identification; the pun refers to his stethoscope. Importantly, the licensed 2024 *My Little Pony Roleplaying Game: Story of the Seasons* **explicitly calls him “Dr. Steth”** and names him, Dr. Horse and Nurse Redheart as Ponyville Hospital staff (p. 14). That establishes **licensed RPG usage**, not an on-screen introduction or a speaking role. [Publisher](https://renegadegamestudios.com/my-little-pony-roleplaying-game-story-of-the-seasons-adventure-sourcebook/) · [Book text](https://www.scribd.com/document/884578036/Adventure-Sourcebook-MLP-RPG-Story-of-the-Seasons-kbT3op).
